title: Agentflow decision-ledger record
description: Contract for one decision in the cross-batch ledger (docs/PENDING-DECISIONS.md). A decision is recorded once as DEC-YYYY-NNN and never removed (只追加、永不移出). It advances by revision (r1, r2 …); a revision may be withdrawn; the current revision may declare equivalent_to an earlier one so downstream pins do not go stale on a text-only change. Downstream documents declare their dependence via decision_deps frontmatter (flat tokens: DEC-YYYY-NNN#rN, DEC-YYYY-NNN#invariant=<text>, optionally #stale_reason=<…>#review_date=YYYY-MM-DD). This schema documents the ledger record shape; the machine enforcement lives in tools/lab/decisions.py (view / check / index).

id.description: Decision identifier, DEC-<YYYY>-<NNN>. Assigned once, never reused or removed.

rev.description: Current revision number (1-based). Bumping it is the only text-changing operation allowed without a stale_reason.

withdrawn.description: Revisions that were retracted (no longer authoritative). A downstream pin to a withdrawn revision is red.

equivalent_to.description: Revisions the current revision is textually equivalent to. A downstream pin to one of these stays green.

terminal.description: Terminal state of the whole decision. Empty means still active. The triad: superseded / withdrawn / deferred.

invariant.description: A statement that must remain true across revisions; downstream docs may pin this instead of a revision.

stale_reason.description: Why a downstream document is allowed to lag behind the current revision. Must accompany review_date.

review_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the stale pin must be re-reviewed; must be today or later to count as a valid exemption.
